metadata.monotonize: per-player before seed/player averaging; after f for transformed SD
metadata.utility_formula: utility = clipped_gain - C * leakage(own choice), leakage = 1 - protection

schema.cell: [row, column] grid index of the equilibrium; row = first player's choice, column = second player's choice; index 0 = no defence, last = maximum privacy
schema.gain: clipped (and optionally monotonised) accuracy gain at the cell, before the penalty
schema.status: nash = pure Nash equilibrium reached, cycle = best responses loop, max_iter = limit hit
schema.path: cells visited by the dynamics (only turns in which somebody moved), starting at [0, 0]
schema.first_player_starts / second_player_star: which player of the pair moves first in the dynamics
schema.comparison: transformed SD equilibrium vs. measured NT equilibrium; differences are transformed - real
schema.summary: aggregates over all ordered C pairs and both move orders
